draft_en.subject: One question — 10G Enterprise SFP Switch
draft_en.body:
Hello,

We have sent you a few mails on "10G Enterprise SFP Switch" and you never had a reason to answer — fair enough. No brochure this time, just one question:

Sergey, for the 4/8-port PoE positions behind your cameras: 8 x PoE+ + 2 x SFP managed - $84.1 USD EXW per unit; unmanaged 8 x PoE - about $26.2. Payment via a third-country account or in CNY is workable. Which of the two would be useful on the next site?

Prices are USD EXW, 2026-10-17 snapshot, valid 15 days.

If it is not relevant now, a one-word reply is enough and I will take you off the catalog mails.

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
